purpose: Predeclared 8-case pilot for candidate_g_cerebras_qwen (Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b, reasoning_effort='none', strict JSON Schema, UNMODIFIED active-control STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION_PROMPT), written and committed to disk BEFORE any qualifying/quality Cerebras API call for this candidate is made (the single reasoning-control smoke test in nlu_cerebras_qwen_frozen_config.json used a synthetic non-benchmark query and predates this plan being locked, per Step 8/Step 9 ordering).
prompt_used: STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION_PROMPT (unmodified active control) -- explicitly NOT CEREBRAS_INTENT_CLARIFIED_PROMPT (the GPT-OSS-only experimental revision).
case_selection_rationale: All 8 query_ids are NEW dev-split items, disjoint from both prior Cerebras GPT-OSS pilots (round 2's nlu_cerebras_gptoss_pilot_plan.json and round 3's nlu_cerebras_intent_revision_pilot_plan.json) on query_id, exact query_text, and template_group -- verified programmatically, see overlap_verification below. Selected to cover every category the task requires: simple entity extraction, constraint-heavy trial question, multi-entity/multi-hop question, cross-source question, ambiguous case, gene/protein/target semantic-role ambiguity, class B, class G, PLUS (within the same 8 slots, since several categories naturally co-occur): a true A_literature_evidence case (slot 1), two non-A intents from the categories most susceptible to generic-A collapse in the prior GPT-OSS rounds -- E_multi_hop_research and D_cross_source_synthesis (slots 3 and 4, the exact two classes GPT-OSS collapsed to A on), a multi-hop/specific-research-operation case (slot 3), and a case with multiple possible entity roles (slot 6, HER2/ERBB2 -- simultaneously gene/protein/target).
known_limitation: No example in the 45-item dev split is a true 'ambiguous ABBREVIATION' case (same limitation documented in both prior Cerebras pilots and the local-Qwen-1.5B pilot). Closest available I_ambiguous proxy used: nlu_v1_0139 ('Is this drug safe?' -- missing disease/drug-identity referent), a DIFFERENT proxy item than either prior pilot used (round 2 used nlu_v1_0136, round 3 used nlu_v1_0140), disclosed here rather than silently reinterpreting the category.

pilot_cases.query_text: What does published research say about JAK2 inhibition in multiple myeloma?
Find completed Phase 2 trials in pediatric patients with melanoma using KRAS inhibitors
Starting from compounds that inhibit EGFR, which ones progressed to trials in non-small cell lung cancer and what do published studies report on their outcomes?
pilot_cases.note: This exact class (E_multi_hop_research) was one of the 2 classes GPT-OSS round-2 collapsed to A_literature_evidence on -- included deliberately as a stress case for the same failure mode, on fresh query material.

pilot_cases.query_text: Is metformin supported by both peer-reviewed literature and an active clinical trial for multiple myeloma?
Which compounds target HER2 and what activity is reported?

gold_entities.note: HER2/ERBB2 is simultaneously gene, protein, and drug target -- gold benchmark scores type as 'target' but semantic_roles has no gold annotation in this benchmark version (documented Phase 2 closure limitation), so semantic_roles is scored representation-only, same treatment as every prior candidate including the active Nemotron control.

pilot_cases.query_text: What Phase 1 trials are evaluating erlotinib in non-small cell lung cancer?

pilot_cases.slot: class_G (second, distinct instance from slot 2, per prior rounds' 2-independent-G-checks convention)
pilot_cases.query_text: Find recruiting Phase 1 trials in adults with breast cancer using PD-1 inhibitors

overlap_verification.method: Programmatic (venv/bin/python, ad hoc, not persisted as project code) comparison of query_id, query_text, and template_group across: this plan's 8 cases, GPT-OSS round-2 pilot (nlu_cerebras_gptoss_pilot_plan.json), GPT-OSS round-3 pilot (nlu_cerebras_intent_revision_pilot_plan.json), and the full 105-example consumed test split.
overlap_verification.result: PASS -- zero overlap on every dimension checked.

rate_limit_discipline: 5 RPM Free Trial cap; extractor's utils.rate_limiter.wait_for_rate_limit throttle wait will be recorded and reported SEPARATELY from true model latency, exactly as corrected in the GPT-OSS round-2 methodology note (do not repeat the throttle-as-latency measurement mistake).
predeclared_pass_gate_reference: Steps 15-21 of the task instruction (structural / entities / intent / constraints / ambiguity / latency gates) -- not restated in full here, applied verbatim at analysis time.
zero_semantic_tuning_commitment: No prompt, taxonomy, entity rule, constraint rule, or ambiguity rule will be changed based on this pilot's results, per Step 10. If systemic quality defects appear, candidate_g_cerebras_qwen is rejected, full stop.
